headline: Root-fixed a CANON-031 lie inside CI itself — the CI Status Beacon reddening on GitHub's own transient 503 — then swept the class and made unattended-publisher transient-degrade a standing structural contract.

items.title: CI Status Beacon degrades on transient GitHub 503 (honest-dark)
items.insight: A health beacon that hard-fails on the provider's own weather reports the repo unhealthy when only GitHub is down. Now: isTransientGhError classifier + retry-with-backoff + degrade to last-known-good (timestamp reveals staleness; 96h freshness gate is the backstop); real errors still surface.

items.title: fetch-rum-from-r2 degrades on transient R2 5xx
items.insight: The check-every-failure-mode sweep found the identical hard-fail in the RUM pull. Transient R2 errors degrade + preserve raw; AccessDenied/config still hard-fail so the standing token-scope blocker stays visible.

items.title: Structural prevention gate for the transient-hard-fail class
items.insight: Sibling to check-build-step-resilience: guards schedule:/workflow_run: publishers that make network calls against transient hard-exits. Live clean 0/27, self-test with teeth; verifiers excluded by design.

items.title: Franchise Architect 301 verified live; S282 verify retired
items.insight: Verified carries against live code instead of trusting them: old football-gm slug 301s to franchise-architect (new slug 200); the S282 verify names a pruned run.

followUps: Ark pattern-share the transient-degrade recipe to studio-ops
